CLI-121.label: I
CLI-121.reason: This report is about required-option selection and an unrelated Java 1.6/TransformerFactory error. It touches CLI parsing, but the mechanism is different: choosing among options based on requirements, not counting nested child groups toward group min/max constraints. No clear overlap with group-presence propagation via `WriteableCommandLine#addOption`.

CLI-122.label: R
CLI-122.reason: This is directly about the same feature area: group semantics, especially child groups and how they should be represented in the command line for constraint checking. The current bug report explicitly says group presence is not counted because groups are never added to `CommandLine`, and the fix should use `WriteableCommandLine#addOption(Option)` when any child is present. That aligns closely with tests involving parent/child options and group detection, so it is highly relevant.
